title: Tsing Hua College International Bachelor Program (Fall 2027)
institution: National Tsing Hua University, Tsing Hua College
about: International bachelor program at National Tsing Hua University's Tsing Hua College for Fall 2027. Applications run from October 1, 2026 to April 22, 2027 (12:00 noon Taiwan time); selection is mainly by document review, with a quota of 180 international students.
requirements: Chinese-taught Group A: TOCFL A2 or HSK level 4 minimum
English-taught tracks: e.g. IELTS 6.0 or TOEFL iBT 82
Online application only; one major per application; late or incomplete applications are not reviewed
